butchering-prepare-desc: Obtain a working knife. Keep a knife ready and build your processing area before bringing meat home. The flint skinning hook and primitive butchering table provide a stone-age route; iron and a cleaver are not prerequisites. Read their current handbook recipes and reserve space for the table. Automatic credit records possession only; obtaining it from another player or an earlier trip also counts. It does not verify the described processing action.
butchering-hook-desc: Obtain a flint skinning-hook block; metal stations do not satisfy this primitive milestone. Knap flint hooks, then use the handbook recipe for a flint skinning hook. Place the station with room beneath it. The hook uses a knife for skinning: a cleaver is not a substitute here. Automatic credit records possession only; obtaining it from another player or an earlier trip also counts. It does not verify the described processing action.
butchering-table-desc: Craft a primitive butchering table using its handbook grid recipe. Simple and advanced tables have separate optional milestones and cannot satisfy this task. This task records its actual crafting output, not ownership: a table occupying an equipment backpack slot is not scanned by ordinary obtain tasks. The primitive table gives a stone-age route. Its recipe consumes a stone knife and axe, so reserve another knife for the hook. Place it like a filled skep using Ctrl with the backpack-slot controls, leaving room for its three-block footprint extending two blocks to the right. Crafting credit does not prove placement or processing.
butchering-retrieve-desc: Obtain an intact supported corpse in ordinary hotbar or backpack inventory. Start with a chicken, hare or fox that fits those slots: a large corpse equipped in a backpack equipment slot is not counted by this inventory objective. Right-click the unharvested animal with an empty active hand to retrieve it. Corpses slow you and spoil, so process promptly. Field harvesting remains an emergency reduced-yield option, not this station route. Credit records corpse possession, not the retrieval action; player graves are unrelated.
butchering-skin-desc: Obtain a raw hide. This optional mammal branch is not a prerequisite for bleeding: birds yield feathers and some species yield fur instead. Put a supported corpse on the hook and hold right-click with a knife to skin it. A cleaver cannot skin here. Leave the corpse hanging to bleed. Automatic credit records raw-hide possession, not how it was harvested.
butchering-bleed-desc: Obtain a bled-out corpse in ordinary hotbar or backpack inventory. Continue with an inventory-sized animal so equipment-slot carrying does not hide it from the tracker. Skin it on the hook with a knife; birds can yield feathers instead of a raw hide, so the raw-hide branch is optional. Leave it hanging while it bleeds: removal is blocked during this stage. Small, medium and large workloads take more than one, two or four game hours respectively. Prepare the blood bucket before this finishes. Take down the bled-out corpse empty-handed. Credit records the resulting corpse state, not the waiting or skinning action; there is no invented dressing station.
butchering-process-desc: Obtain ordinary raw meat, not proof of table processing. Place the bled-out corpse on the butchering table. Hold right-click with a knife or cleaver until processing finishes; a cleaver uses less durability here. Collect the available meat and other products promptly. Species and condition affect yield, so no particular rare product is required. Automatic credit records possession only; obtaining it from another player or an earlier trip also counts. It does not verify the described processing action.
butchering-blood-desc: Obtain blood in a carried bucket or other supported liquid container. Before the corpse finishes bleeding, put an empty wooden bucket beneath the hanging carcass following the native guide and check that it receives blood. You can prepare this optional branch as soon as you have a table; do not wait until after bleeding. Collect the bucket and carry it in the hotbar or backpack so its liquid contents are scanned. Carry at least one whole litre: the existing liquid tracker counts whole litres, not portions. A full bucket is not required. Credit does not prove you caught it yourself. Inspect blood recipes before committing a batch. The pinned handbook specifies a wooden bucket below the hook; the inspected capture path checks beneath the hanging carcass rather than promising a universal 2–4-block hook distance. Use the native guide and check the receiving bucket. A saucepan is not verified here. Do not confuse the 0.2-litre sausage recipe with this whole-litre obtain threshold.
butchering-preserve-desc: Obtain a Butchering smoked food item. Use the smoking rack with a firepit below and an ingredient whose handbook entry supports smoking; ordinary raw meat is sufficient, prime meat is not required. Follow the installed rack and food handbook instructions, then collect and store the result before it spoils. Automatic credit proves possession of smoked food, not a smoking action; cooking alone is no longer presented as an equivalent outcome.
butchering-offal-desc: Obtain clean offal, not proof of barrel operation. If your animal yielded bloody offal, use the handbook barrel-cleaning recipe before its food recipes. Do not expect every species to supply it. This is an optional use for an actual product, not a requirement to hunt a rare animal. Automatic credit records possession only; obtaining it from another player or an earlier trip also counts. It does not verify the described processing action.
butchering-sinew-desc: Obtain dry sinew, not proof of waiting for curing. If you obtained wet sinew, dry it before using the dried product in a compatible bow, sewing or glue recipe. Use its handbook entry for the current drying and ingredient rules. Automatic credit records possession only; obtaining it from another player or an earlier trip also counts. It does not verify the described processing action.
butchering-bones-desc: Obtain a strong bone. This optional branch targets an actual Butchering material: not every species yields the same remains. Some table-processed animals leave a bone carcass that can be broken for products. Inspect the strong-bone recipes before hunting for this output. The pack disables the bone pickaxe, and some specialist recipes are class-gated; no such tool is required for this quest. Credit proves possession, not breaking a carcass or crafting a tool.
butchering-bag-desc: Obtain any Butchering bag. The primitive bag offers an early route; inspect recipes, capacities and corpse sizes rather than assuming every corpse fits. Keep the bag unequipped in ordinary hotbar/backpack inventory until credited: equipment slots are not scanned as carried goods. Then equip it for the next trip. A cleaver improves table work but cannot skin on the hook. Credit proves bag possession, not a transport trip or tool upgrade.
butchering-hunt-desc: Chickens are easy prey; larger animals fight back. Butchering lets you bring an unharvested corpse home with an empty active hand. Prepare the hook and table before the next hunt: follow the Butchering chapter from Obtain a working knife. Field cutting remains available at reduced yield. This quest still records a chicken kill, not completion of carcass processing.
butchering-leather-desc: Obtain finished leather. A raw hide from skinning starts the leatherwork route; it is not finished leather. Follow the linked hide preparation and tanning quests, including weak and strong tannin. An oiled hide produces a pelt, not proof of tanned leather. Automatic credit records finished-leather possession, not the tanning action or the hide's origin.
butchering-leather-links: Leatherwork: get hide, soak hide, scrape hide, prepare hide, make leather, weak tannin, strong tannin.
butchering-iw-links: Immersive Woodworking: woodworking boards and its bark by-products for the installed bark-based tannin recipes instead of assuming vanilla logs.
butchering-tailor-links: Tailor's Delight: knap an awl and make a needle lead into sewing. Inspect optional hide bundles and installed finished-goods recipes; specialist tools are not prerequisites here.
butchering-hunt-link: Before the next hunt: prepare a knife and processing area.
butchering-bh-link: With Better Husbandry installed, review breeding and stock management before selecting animals for slaughter. Husbandry is an optional source of animals, not proof of processing.
butchering-lw-link: With Livestock Welfare installed, review feeding infrastructure and breeding before culling. Do not treat this kill objective as a welfare or feeding check.
butchering-native-guides: Read the Butchering guide and species and yields guide. Workstations and products also open their native handbook pages when their icons are clicked.
butchering-ef-rack-link: Expanded Foods: its meat-rack route and dry-aging are separate optional routes, not smoking credit.
butchering-chef-salt-link: Chef's Tricks offers salt crystallization and drying salt crystals for optional salting recipes. This is not a requirement to obtain an unsalted smoked product.
butchering-ef-sausage-link: Expanded Foods: sausage preparation is an optional use; inspect the recipe for accepted ingredients and do not assume any meat or offal substitutes.
butchering-bonemeal-link: For ordinary bones, grind bonemeal offers a separate use. Ordinary bone is not a strong bone.
butchering-cleaver-link: Optional table upgrade: make a cleaver. It never replaces the hook knife.
butchering-javelin-desc: Knap an Armory javelin head from suitable stone or flint, then combine the head with a stick in the crafting grid. Obtain a plain javelin in carried inventory. This proves possession, not a knapping event or a javelin kill. It is an optional hunting choice; the first-hunt chicken kill remains unchanged.
butchering-knapped-hook-desc: Knap the flint-hook pattern: its output is two hook components. Obtain a flint hook before assembling the primitive skinning-hook block with logs, sticks, flint and resin or fat. Possession does not prove a knapping event; the skinning-hook milestone remains available independently for existing saves.
butchering-raw-slab-desc: With Rustic Cookery and Butchering installed, eligible redmeat or bushmeat carcass yields are grouped into whole slabs at the butcher workstation. In the pinned pack each complete six-piece group becomes a slab; species, weight and yield can leave only ordinary meat. Obtain a raw slab. Slicing goes the other way: place a slab and hold right-click with a knife to remove pieces, or use a cleaver. Slicing does not create slabs. Keep a whole slab for smoking; this optional branch never blocks ordinary butchering.
butchering-rustic-rack-title: Craft a Rustic Cookery smoke rack
butchering-rustic-rack-desc: Craft Rustic Cookery’s smoke rack using logs in the upper corners and sticks in the remaining pattern cells (LSL/SSS/SSS). Obtain the ingredients, then grid-craft the rack for automatic credit; placement is not tracked. This wooden rack is a different machine from Butchering’s metal-hook smoking rack.
butchering-smoked-slab-desc: Place a whole raw slab on the Rustic Cookery smoke rack by right-clicking. Partial slabs do not fit. Supply smoke and wait until the rack reports fully smoked, then obtain the smoked slab in carried inventory. Progress scales with smoke strength and pauses without smoke; a nearby fire alone is not guaranteed to suffice. The pinned pack uses Real Smoke. Without that provider the mod has an enclosed-room firepit fallback. This task proves the output, not your placement, fire or elapsed smoking time.
butchering-blood-sausage-desc: Obtain clean offal and blood, then grid-craft raw blood sausage. Arrange clean offal above a wooden bucket containing at least 0.2 litres of blood, above two raw or cured redmeat. Alternatives are four raw/cured bushmeat or three raw poultry. The bucket is retained. This is a grid recipe, not a machine process. The separate blood milestone needs a whole carried litre because the obtain tracker floors liquid litres; sausage crafting itself needs only the recipe amount. Cook or smoke raw sausage before eating.
butchering-hide-glue-desc: Obtain hide glue in a carried liquid container: at least one whole litre is needed for automatic credit. In the cooking pot, the pinned recipes use one litre of water with three scraped small hides or three scraped medium hides. Hot hide glue hardens to cold glue; the recipe also reheats cold hide glue. Either hide-glue state counts. This is possession of glue, not proof of cooking; do not discard scarce hides before checking the handbook recipe.
butchering-sinew-glue-desc: Obtain at least one whole litre of sinew glue in a carried container. Grind dried sinew, then use the cooking-pot recipe with one litre of water and three ground sinew. The output is cold sinew glue. Sinew is species-dependent, so this optional material route does not gate base processing. Automatic credit proves the carried glue, not grinding or cooking.
butchering-metal-hook-desc: Smith Butchering hook components using the one-hook or four-hook anvil pattern and obtain a copper, bronze or iron hook. A flint hook cannot satisfy this upgrade. These are components, not the assembled skinning-hook block. Use them in metal skinning hooks or the smoking-rack grid recipe; obtaining one does not prove personal smithing.
butchering-smoking-rack-desc: Obtain metal hook components, planks, sticks and resin, then grid-craft a Butchering smoking rack (HPH/SRS/HPH). The recipe accepts copper/bronze hooks for the copper rack, or iron hooks for the iron rack. This is not the Rustic Cookery wooden slab rack. Use Butchering’s native guide for its smoking setup; the task detects the grid output, not placement, fire or smoking.
butchering-simple-table-desc: Obtain planks, two copper plates, and copper/bronze knife, shears and cleaver, then grid-craft the simple table (KSL/PCP). The plank ingredient occurs twice. Check native recipe quantities before crafting. Tables are backpack-slot workstations: the obtain tracker does not scan equipment slots, so this milestone detects the grid output instead of carried equipment or placement. The pinned table asset has base efficiency 1.0 versus primitive 0.8; actual yields also depend on configuration and animal.
butchering-advanced-table-desc: Obtain planks, two iron plates, and iron knife, shears and cleaver, then grid-craft the advanced table (KSL/PIP). This is a separate tier-specific milestone; primitive and simple tables cannot satisfy it. Grid-craft credit avoids the unscanned backpack equipment slot. The pinned table asset has base efficiency 1.2, not a guaranteed personal yield bonus. Placement and processing are not detected.
butchering-prime-desc: Obtain a raw prime cut if an eligible carcass yields one. Prime meat is not guaranteed from every species or hunt. This is an optional collectible branch, not a prerequisite of ordinary meat, slabs, offal, preservation or workstation upgrades. Possession does not prove a specific carcass or butchering action.
